analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 205,750) vs SMA5 (KRW 196,950) / SMA20 (KRW 214,688) / SMA50 (KRW 241,128): Confirmed entry into a sideways range, above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/SMA50.
· Significantly lower position relative to SMA100 (KRW 256,556) / SMA200 (KRW 236,270): Continued weakening of mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (39.7%): A price range significantly down from the high, though higher than historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (41.9→41.9): Neutral zone maintained, indicating lack of directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (681.4217→-1332.6921): Worsening, entering weak convergence, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 214,688): Sideways movement around the middle band, with a band width of 24.16% indicating a contraction in volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (KRW 204,500): Located just below the current price, a higher support compared to Pivot S1 (KRW 173,633).
· Swing resistance level (KRW 209,000): Located just above the current price, potential for a short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: 5-day high KRW 213,500, 5-day low KRW 179,200. 20-day high KRW 249,000, 20-day low KRW 179,200. Diagnosed as a sideways range with the 5-day low matching the 20-day low, and the 5-day high below the 20-day high.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.53): Below the 5-day average volume, reducing the reliability of current price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Lack of direction due to neutral RSI, undeveloped ADX trend, and subdued volume. A phase for waiting and observing indicator changes.
